{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Check the unique values in customer_segment
unique_segments = df['customer_segment'].unique()

# Check the unique values in channel
unique_channels = df['channel'].unique()

# Check if 'NEW' is in customer_segment
has_new = 'NEW' in unique_segments

# Check if 'paid_search' is in channel
has_paid_search = 'paid_search' in unique_channels

# Check if converted is only 0 or 1
valid_converted = set(df['converted'].unique()) == {0, 1}

# Print results
unique_segments, unique_channels, has_new, has_paid_search, valid_converted"}
